**Preface**

- Origin: diploma thesis, Hannover 2010, quantum memory channels, how
  deep their memory runs
- One small, self-contained question out of it: how finely can total
  erasure be divided?
- Who did what, honest and brief: math from the thesis, text by me,
  the LLM share named as it actually was
- Audience: curious readers without background; pictures and examples
  instead of thesis notation
- Route: memory as the physical picture → classical → quantum
- Part 1 of 2; part 2: a rigid family of channels (Clifford)
:::
